# uzc_ip_addresses (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud IP addresses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_ip_addresses" "example" {
  vpc = "example-vpc"
}

output "ip_addresses" {
  value = [for ip in data.uzc_ip_addresses.example.ip_addresses : ip.ipaddress]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `vpc` (String) Filter to IP addresses attached to this VPC slug.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_addresses` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_addresses))
